response.justification: The candidate demonstrates strong software engineering experience across multiple languages (C++, D, Rust not explicitly mentioned) and domains, including geospatial projects (GISCollective) and low-latency systems (Dunnhumby). However, direct experience with modern C++ for routing/data pipelines, distributed systems, and navigation accuracy improvements is unclear. Their focus appears more web/mobile-centric than core routing/tiling systems.
strengths: Extensive experience with geospatial data processing (GISCollective platform)
Proven track record in high-performance systems (Dunnhumby, low-latency apps)
Strong software engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, refactoring)
concerns: Lacks explicit modern C++/Rust experience for routing pipelines (primary requirement)
Limited evidence of distributed systems fault tolerance/consistency work
No direct experience with navigation/routing accuracy improvements or traffic signal integration
